<UserControl x:Class="SunEyeVision.UI.Shell.Controls.Shell.ImageResultControl"
 xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
 xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
 xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
 xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
 xmlns:composition="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.Plugin.Wpf.Controls.Native.Composition.Results.ResultShell;assembly=SunEyeVision.Plugin.Wpf"
 xmlns:results="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.Plugin.Wpf.Controls.Native.Composition.Results.PropertyList;assembly=SunEyeVision.Plugin.Wpf"
 xmlns:sources="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.Plugin.Wpf.Controls.Native.Composition.ImageSources;assembly=SunEyeVision.Plugin.Wpf"
 mc:Ignorable="d" d:DesignHeight="750" d:DesignWidth="780">
 <UserControl.Resources><BooleanToVisibilityConverter x:Key="VisibleWhenTrue"/></UserControl.Resources>
 <composition:ResultWorkspaceShell x:Name="Workspace" HelpContent="请选择节点查看当前运行声明；主结果区历史、图像叠层及背景替换、未接入的图形文字与ROI编辑均明确未实现，相关入口禁用。">
  <composition:ResultWorkspaceShell.PropertyListContent>
   <results:PropertyListView x:Name="ModuleResultTreeView" SelectedItemChanged="OnResultTreeSelectionChanged"/>
  </composition:ResultWorkspaceShell.PropertyListContent>
  <composition:ResultWorkspaceShell.SourceStripContent>
   <StackPanel Visibility="{Binding ShowImagePreview, Converter={StaticResource VisibleWhenTrue}}">
    <TextBlock x:Name="SourceStatusMessage" Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeTextDisabledBrush}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
    <sources:ImageSourceStrip x:Name="ImagePreviewContent"/>
   </StackPanel>
  </composition:ResultWorkspaceShell.SourceStripContent>
 </composition:ResultWorkspaceShell>
</UserControl>

<Window x:Class="SunEyeVision.UI.Shell.Windows.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        xmlns:local="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI"
        xmlns:windows="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Shell.Windows"
        xmlns:constants="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.Plugin.SDK.UI.Constants;assembly=SunEyeVision.Plugin.SDK"
        xmlns:convertersUI="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Converters.UI"
        xmlns:convertersWorkflow="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Converters.Workflow"
        xmlns:convertersPath="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Converters.Path"
        xmlns:convertersNode="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Converters.Node"
        xmlns:convertersVisibility="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Converters.Visibility"
        xmlns:canvas="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Features.WorkflowUI.Canvas"
        xmlns:toolbox="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Shell.Controls.Toolbox"
        xmlns:shell="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Shell.Controls.Shell"

        xmlns:common="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Shell.Controls.Common"
        xmlns:panels="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Shell.Controls.Panels"
        xmlns:sdk="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.Plugin.SDK.UI.Controls;assembly=SunEyeVision.Plugin.SDK"
        xmlns:base="clr-namespace:SunEyeVision.UI.Themes.Base"
        mc:Ignorable="d"
        Title="太阳眼视觉 - 机器视觉平台" Height="900" Width="1600"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        WindowState="Maximized"
        WindowStyle="None"
        ResizeMode="CanResize"
        WindowChrome.WindowChrome="{x:Static windows:MainWindow.MainWindowChrome}"
        Background="{DynamicResource ThemeWindowBackgroundBrush}"
        Loaded="MainWindow_Loaded">

    <Window.Resources>
        <ResourceDictionary>
            <convertersUI:BoolToVisibilityConverter x:Key="BoolToVisibilityConverter"/>
            <convertersPath:SmartPathConverter x:Key="SmartPathConverter"/>
            <convertersVisibility:InverseBoolToVisibilityConverter x:Key="InverseBoolToVisibilityConverter"/>
            <convertersUI:ExpandIconConverter x:Key="ExpandIconConverter"/>
            <convertersVisibility:NullToVisibilityConverter x:Key="NullToVisibilityConverter"/>
            <convertersNode:ImageAreaHeightConverter x:Key="ImageAreaHeightConverter"/>
        </ResourceDictionary>
    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid>
    <DockPanel>
        <shell:ShellTopBarControl x:Name="TopBarHost" DockPanel.Dock="Top" DataContext="{Binding TopBar}"/>


        <!-- ========== 主内容区域 ========== -->
        <Grid x:Name="MainContentGrid" Loaded="MainContentGrid_Loaded">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" x:Name="ToolboxColumn" MinWidth="52" MaxWidth="230"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" x:Name="WorkflowColumn" MinWidth="400"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="700" x:Name="RightPanelColumn" MinWidth="40" MaxWidth="900"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="24"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <!-- ========== 左侧工具箱 - 使用双模ToolboxControl ========== -->
            <Border Grid.Column="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" Background="{DynamicResource ThemeWorkspaceBackgroundBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.DividerBrush}}" BorderThickness="0,0,1,0">
                <toolbox:ToolboxControl DataContext="{Binding Toolbox}" x:Name="ToolboxContent"/>
            </Border>


            <shell:ShellWorkspaceControl Grid.Column="1" x:Name="WorkspaceHost" DataContext="{Binding Workspace}" Loaded="WorkspaceHost_Loaded"/>
            <!-- 右侧分割器 - 工作区和右侧面板之间（可折叠，折叠逻辑内聚） -->
            <common:CollapsibleSplitterBox Grid.Column="2" Width="8" MinWidth="8"
                                           ResizeDirection="Columns"
                                           CollapseDirection="Right"
                                           CollapsedSize="0"
                                           x:Name="RightPanelSplitter"/>

            <!-- ========== 右侧面板：图像显示 + 数据分析 + 日志 ========== -->
            <Border Grid.Column="3" Grid.Row="0" Background="{DynamicResource ThemePanelBackgroundBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ThemeBorderBrush}" BorderThickness="0">
                <Grid x:Name="RightPanelGrid">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*" MinHeight="40" MaxHeight="1000"/>  <!-- Row 0: 图像显示区域（自适应） -->
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" MinHeight="4" MaxHeight="4"/>  <!-- Row 1: 分隔条（可拖动） -->
                        <RowDefinition Height="200" MinHeight="200" MaxHeight="600"/>  <!-- Row 2: 数据分析和日志面板（默认高度200px，可拖动调整） -->
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                            <!-- 图像结果区：图像显示 + 模块结果 + 图像预览 -->
                            <shell:ImageResultControl x:Name="ImageResultHost" DataContext="{Binding ImageResult}"/>

                    <!-- 右侧面板内部分隔器 - 支持拖动调整并保存 -->
                    <GridSplitter Grid.Row="1" Height="4" Width="Auto"
                                 ResizeDirection="Rows"
                                 Background="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.SplitterBackgroundBrush}}"
                                 ShowsPreview="False"
                                 ResizeBehavior="PreviousAndNext"
                                 HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                 DragStarted="ImagePropertySplitter_DragStarted"
                                 DragCompleted="ImagePropertySplitter_DragCompleted"
                                 DragDelta="ImagePropertySplitter_DragDelta"
                                 Cursor="SizeNS">
                        <GridSplitter.Style>
                            <Style TargetType="GridSplitter">
                                <Style.Triggers>
                                    <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.SplitterHoverBrush}}"/>
                                    </Trigger>
                                </Style.Triggers>
                            </Style>
                        </GridSplitter.Style>
                    </GridSplitter>

                    <!-- ========== Row 2: 数据分析和日志 ========== -->
                    <Border Grid.Row="2" Background="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.PanelBackgroundBrush}}" BorderThickness="0">
                        <TabControl x:Name="BottomPanelTabControl"
                                    Background="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.PanelBackgroundBrush}}"
                                    BorderThickness="0">
                            <TabControl.Resources>
                                <!-- TabItem 头样式（随主题：未选中灰字 / 悬停有底 / 选中主题色指示线） -->
                                <Style TargetType="TabItem">
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.TextSecondaryBrush}}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Template">
                                        <Setter.Value>
                                            <ControlTemplate TargetType="TabItem">
                                                <Border x:Name="Bd"
                                                        Background="Transparent"
                                                        BorderThickness="0,0,0,2"
                                                        BorderBrush="Transparent"
                                                        Padding="12,6">
                                                    <ContentPresenter ContentSource="Header"
                                                                      HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                                      VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Border>
                                                <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                                    <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                                        <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.ControlHoverBackgroundBrush}}"/>
                                                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.TextPrimaryBrush}}"/>
                                                    </Trigger>
                                                    <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                                        <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.AccentBrush}}"/>
                                                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource {x:Static base:ThemeKeys.AccentBrush}}"/>
                                                    </Trigger>
                                                </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                            </ControlTemplate>
                                        </Setter.Value>
                                    </Setter>
                                </Style>
                            </TabControl.Resources>
                            <!-- 第一个TabItem: 数据分析（动态显示） -->


                            <!-- 第二个TabItem: 日志 -->
                            <TabItem Header="日志" Padding="12,6">
                                <panels:LogPanelControl x:Name="LogPanelContent"
                                                         VerticalAlignment="Stretch"
                                                         HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                            </TabItem>
                        </TabControl>
                    </Border>


                </Grid>
            </Border>

            <!-- ========== 状态栏 (24px) ========== -->
            <shell:StatusBarControl Grid.Column="1" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Grid.Row="1" DataContext="{Binding StatusBar}"/>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>

        <!-- 方案加载遮罩：主界面先显示，方案和相机异步恢复期间阻止操作并提供明确进度。 -->
        <Grid x:Name="SolutionLoadingOverlay"
              Panel.ZIndex="1000"
              Visibility="Collapsed"
              Background="#CC15171A"
              IsHitTestVisible="True">
            <Border Width="480" MinHeight="250" Padding="32"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                    Background="{DynamicResource ThemePanelBackgroundBrush}"
                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ThemeBorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                    CornerRadius="6">
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <TextBlock Text="正在加载解决方案" FontSize="20" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeTextPrimaryBrush}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="SolutionLoadingStageText" Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,20,0,0"
                               FontSize="14" Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeTextPrimaryBrush}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="SolutionLoadingDetailText" Grid.Row="2" Margin="0,7,0,0"
                               FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeTextSecondaryBrush}"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                    <ProgressBar x:Name="SolutionLoadingProgressBar" Grid.Row="3" Height="8"
                                 Margin="0,24,0,0" IsIndeterminate="True"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="SolutionLoadingElapsedText" Grid.Row="4" Margin="0,16,0,0"
                               HorizontalAlignment="Right" FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeTextSecondaryBrush}"/>
                </Grid>
            </Border>
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</Window>

## 2026-10-28 当前实施状态

用户已批准整批应用，原13项候选完整保留，新增真实Shutdown→卸载→重载不可复活回归，共14项。正式ImageSourceCases已纳入四组新消费者依赖；尚未编译/运行，不称通过。旧候选说明仅历史。

# D07 原结果工作区真实生产链回归候选归档

- 初版基线：0adcc484；本轮测试候选从92c83101继续，参照root2834e3ae未连接产品源码，只改独立测试与本交接。
- 当前分支：codex/d07-native-roi-host，独立workflow-overview树。
- 执行者：Codex / source_editor。
- 本批仅新增tests/SunEyeVision.UI.Tests/ResultWorkspaceProductionTests.cs及本交接；不改产品、公共库、runner或项目，不构建，不写Release。
- 候选状态：明确依赖root在途/只读review提案，未应用、未获本批完整实施准入的产品不得借此测试提交视作已批准或已闭环。

## 实际组装与受控结果

fixture先注册正式plugins中的ImageLoad Runtime，并注册受控Probe工具实际定义。方案含正式图像源A和受控结果节点B及真实连接，Main ctor必须加载已打开Solution并保持正式flow.Nodes引用；随后实际ImageResultControl.Initialize/Window.Show/Loaded取得x:Name Workspace及实际私有_workspacePresenter，不创建第二Presenter。

Probe使用真正ToolExecutor.Run，ExecutionOwner=doc.ExecutionOwner、WorkflowId=flow.Id、NodeId=真实节点local ID，真实request.GetInvocationIdentity后创建FrozenOutputResources/ImageFrameAddress/实际Domain/像素；经DeclaredOutputSnapshot.Publish正式冻结，不new假RunIdentity、不new假publication。A产出逐项符合实际ImageLoad Runtime输出schema（image/gray alias及真实宽高），B使用自身明确IOutputContractProvider声明image/region/point/count。结果经真实NodeResultManager.UpdateNodeResult进入正式WorkflowContext及Main刷新通知，非直接调用结果Presenter.Present。

## 当前八项完整链候选

1. Loaded_real_workspace_uses_same_publication_in_two_independent_panes_and_switches_only_selected_side：初始输入A/输出B不同Frame，选输出A使同一来源publication双侧借阅；左清空不影响右独立借阅；切回B只改输出，表的B publication仍同实例/current。
2. Undeclared_region_resources_do_not_draw_and_same_frame_selection_rejects_old_publication：结果虽含真实Region资源，因没有正式显示声明，两侧均不得产生推测区域图层/默认色；真实同Frame选择仍可高亮，新结果高亮后旧pub/stamp通知不得清新选择。明确清选择及切来源后仍无推测Region图层，不冒称完整graphics/text。
3. Foreign_workflow_or_document_results_never_supply_display_images：同真实工具准入但scope/ExecutionOwner不属于当前方案的结果不能供输出图；合法A上游输入仍独立。
4. Unload_reload_reuses_original_views_and_final_shutdown_drains_publication_owners：实际Unloaded退双pane不提前退表pub，重载同原View换实际Presenter；Shutdown/context排空/结果root关闭后资源释放各一次，独立pixel lease活过结果root退出，最终拒绝disposed读取。
5. Actual_file_selection_uses_preview_without_ROI_authority_and_clear_image_does_not_retire_table：经正式Host节点配置接纳ImageSourcePolicy本地文件，实际选择Source及CurrentImageIndex触发native preview；检查真实像素、BorrowCurrentImage=null，ClearImageCommand清图不退表pub。
6. Original_shape_DP_reentry_installs_B_in_both_panes_and_old_A_cannot_clear_or_write_output：先把output选成input的同Frame且已有highlight，再由外层选择A的input.Clear触发原ImageViewBox.ShapeList DP真实回调；回调内投递同pub选择B，捕获B双pane ShapeList和shape对象引用，外层A退出后必须完全保持B，不得随后清output或写旧A。无产品测试钩子。
7. Explicit_clear_removes_highlight_after_publication_dispose_even_when_Main_still_holds_it：显式Dispose当前真实pub但Main仍引用，ClearResultHighlight必须清双侧旧highlight；合法上游背景来源及Frame保留，不要求退役pub仍current。
8. New_run_notified_during_failed_capture_is_eventually_presented_after_the_exception：清当前所选node的context旧值并退pub，让真实Capture回退到正式参数GetOutputContract；仅受控工具的实例一次性回调清hook→真正ToolExecutor/NodeResultManager发布新run→抛FormatException。真实Presenter的异常finally须保_refreshAgain重排最新，最终原output显示新Frame/像素81且表身份为该真实run。没有调用私有Refresh/设置历史或伪造publication。

选择延迟回归读取Main真实事件的既有multicast transport再投递不可变ResultSelection，测试实际生产订阅者的旧stamp门禁；不Invoke私有renderer、不写shape/canvas、不造第二Presenter。它不冒称替代真实可视结果表的用户点击/VM人工高亮验收。

## 精确依赖及真实未完

- 必须与公共Shell只读InputViewport/OutputViewport、ImageResultControl.Workspace/_workspacePresenter/Loaded/Unloaded、ResultWorkspacePresenter/ImagePlan/Main.NativeResults及LocalResultImagePreview全部真实生产接线一起编译。
- root报告最新只读提案已补：同当前snapshot优先借Main publication且不Own、正式ancestor依赖图、外部navigation index优先旧key、旧selection先gate、构造/Dispose聚合。这些未应用的修正不因本测试归档而被执行或批准。
- 当前本独立源码没有这些完整产品接线，不能执行或宣称通过。测试保原完整要求，不通过伪造工作流加载、改断言为无图、提前退表pub、错误frame alias或改scope来绕过。
- 初版92c83101曾按当时不合规的固定橙色枚举资源实现断言有Region层，该断言现已撤回，不能保留为产品合同；root2834e3ae只读候选已撤自动枚举Region。当前无正式显示定义时真实测试必须无推测层；正式显示定义、完整graphics/text/Overlay、真实VS设计、VM同态/用户人工仍是实质未完成，不因选择高亮可用而记完成。
- 最后Global失败经只读定位是GlobalVariableValueConverter强制scalar→array持久化，已交root产品线；本批未改SendData DESIGN断言或其夹具。

本轮同一新C#八项候选仅纯语法检查与git diff --check，非语义编译或运行成绩。未构建/运行/VS/人工，不能按数量记完成。主线应先归档本候选与原review制品、保持真实未完，完整闭包和准入就绪后再统一同源规定UI/full及正式轨，不为本候选单独请求半闭包实施批准。
